visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene is set in a Japanese-style izakaya with warm lighting and numerous posters on the wall. A group of five men are seated around a table, while a woman in a red dress sits next to a man who is initially slumped over his seat. The men are drinking beer and chatting. (2) The man in the black shirt suddenly sits up and begins shouting at the group at the other table. He gestures aggressively with his hands and points. The woman in the red dress attempts to restrain him, placing her hand on his arm and shoulder. The group at the next table reacts with laughter and shouting back. (3) The confrontation escalates as the woman begins to bow repeatedly toward the other table, seemingly apologizing. She holds her hands out in a placating gesture. The man in black continues to shout and point, appearing increasingly agitated. (4) In a sudden shift, the woman in the red dress picks up a plate of food from the table and forcefully slaps it onto the man's head. The man immediately collapses back into his seat, slumped over the table. The woman then calmly sits down, adjusts her hair, and looks at him. (5) The woman leans over the slumped man and touches his head, appearing to ask a question while the background characters remain in their positions, though the shouting has subsided.
